plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF

source_policy.map: The selected domain is derived with the build-70450 available-section Map reader and its active ancestor closure. A missing, inactive, malformed, or unavailable ancestor is fatal. This contract declares the Map source as available-section coverage, not complete global Map coverage.
source_policy.gameobjects: Global GameObject startup is excluded by profile policy. The geometry kernel does not request GameObjectDisplayInfo; this declared exclusion is not an observed source failure or cause.
source_policy.models: Only models registered by actual selected-domain placement requests are converted and published. Coverage emits placement-only model scope only when startup has no global TempList rows, GODI startup_facts().reads is zero, and the VMO artifact inventory exactly matches used_models. Missing, unavailable, malformed, or unsupported selected WDT, ADT, M2, WMO, or WMO group input is fatal.
source_policy.liquids: LiquidMaterial and LiquidType are read and validated as complete sources. LiquidObject is out of scope and is not requested.

verification.source_authentication: Offline verification authenticates package bytes, rebuilds VMap associations from retained placement proofs, and checks declared source/domain coverage. It is not an independent client snapshot.

facts: selected map ID and active ancestor closure
Map available-section byte and row facts, section admission states, and declared partial-source scope
global GameObject scope excluded by profile policy, excluded_by_profile reason, GODI request_made=false, and startup reads zero
placement-only model scope derived from startup and the exact used_models/VMO-artifact inventory
complete LiquidMaterial and LiquidType source facts
LiquidObject out of scope and request_made=false
size and SHA-256 bindings for every published VMap artifact and placement proof

limits.meaning: All plan budgets and product ceilings are downward-only. Callback staging and map assembly fail closed on limits; no output is truncated. Run component state remains provisional until the shared package lifecycle seals the collision component.

resume: An incomplete collision component is rerun through the same selected-domain producer and replayed into the common package state. A sealed component is not rewritten; package verification remains available without client input.
excluded: DB2, game-table, camera, or navigation output
global GameObject startup models and dtree
legacy_preservation: v14, v15, v18, and v21 keep their existing plan, publication, and verification identities; no earlier acceptance transfers to v22.
